name: Fix discriminated-union narrowing in an API client
prompt: src/client.ts does not compile: unwrap() narrows only the "error" variant and then reads `data`, which the "pending" variant does not have. Fix unwrap() so it handles every variant of ApiResponse<T>: return `data` for "success", throw new Error(res.message) for "error", and throw new Error("response is pending") for "pending". Do not widen the types or use escape-hatch casts. Assertions type-check the project and then run test.ts.
